description: Specify who can raise Requisitions (by Role and/or via User Assignments), and optionally restrict raising Requisitions to a scope (User Assignment / Department / Designation / Company). Nobody may raise a requisition unless a record here allows them — create one record per Who+Scope pairing.

fields.description: A label for this configuration (e.g. "Org-wide Hiring Managers", "Sales Dept Leads").
fields.label: Configuration Name

fields.description: Set on the built-in System Manager configuration. It cannot be deleted and must keep the System Manager role, so administrators can never lock themselves out of raising requisitions.
fields.label: Default Configuration

fields.options: Each record pairs a group of people (who may raise requisitions) with the scope within which they may raise. Add more records for different Who+Scope combinations. Raising is denied by default: a user may raise only if some record here allows them. The built-in Default - System Managers record lets System Managers raise for all companies, departments and designations; create a record for everyone else.

fields.description: Users holding any of these Roles may raise requisitions under this configuration. Combined with the User Assignments below using OR — either one grants access.
fields.label: Roles Allowed to Raise Requisitions

fields.description: Configure which employees are allowed to raise requisitions using User Assignment attributes. Combined with the Roles above using OR — either one grants access.
fields.label: Employees Allowed to Raise Requisitions

fields.options:
Scope By — tick one or more bases below; each selected basis reveals its selector and requires at least one value. A requisition must satisfy all selected bases. Tick nothing for organization-wide scope.
Company, Department and Designation cascade: the Departments list is limited to the selected Companies, and the Designations list to the selected Departments. Changing a Company or Department clears the selections below it that no longer apply.

fields.description: User Assignments whose resolved employees define this scope. The assignment's own attributes decide who it covers.
fields.label: Scope of Raising Requisitions (User Assignments)

fields.description: Requisitions for these Companies are in scope. Top of the cascade — narrows the Departments and Designations below.
fields.label: Companies in Scope

fields.description: Requisitions for these Departments are in scope. Limited to the Companies selected above.
fields.label: Departments in Scope

fields.description: Requisitions for these Designations are in scope. Limited to the Departments selected above.
fields.label: Designations in Scope

name: Raise Requisition Scope
